content.title: A complete look at the cast of 'Survivor 50' through photos
content.text: April 1, 2026, 1:10 p.m. ETThe "Survivor 50" castIncluded 24 players from all eras of the show, including the first season.The cast, the largest ever for a season of "Survivor", will be divided into three tribes of eight players each to start the game. The tribe names will be Cila, Kalo and Vatu.It's the sixth season where every player is a returning contestant, joining All-Stars (Season 8), Heroes vs. Villains (Season 20), Cambodia - Second Chance (Season 31), Game Changers (Season 34) and Winners at War (Season 40).The theme of Season 50 is "In the Hands of the Fans."Scroll through for a look at all the contestants.Robert Voets, CBSThe Cila
